args.explanation: The case was opened as a chargeback for a Point‑of‑Interaction error (duplicate/incorrect amount). The merchant had already issued a full refund of the transaction amount (8385 ¢) as shown by the case status (refunded_minor = 8385). Since the cardholder has been fully reimbursed, the merchant has no liability. I therefore accepted the dispute, which resolves the case without further action or cost.
